methods.label: Follow the implications
methods.explanation: Start with any Crup. It must be a Dramp, and every Dramp is an Arog, so it must also be an Arog. Every Arog is a Braf, so this Crup is also a Braf. Since the reasoning applies to every Crup, all Crups are both Arogs and Brafs. The answer is \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
methods.levelReason: Following universal statements through a short implication chain is elementary logical reasoning appropriate for AMC 10.
